steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Create an RFQ first stage and an unvisited Technical/RFP second stage.
Work only on the first stage initially, leaving the RFP tab unvisited.
Configure the first RFQ stage with a pricing template.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Set the event schedule required for publishing.
Open the publish confirmation while the RFP stage remains unvisited.
Verify the unvisited-stage warning is shown in the confirmation flow.
Verify the publish confirmation cannot be accepted while the stage is unvisited.
Close the blocked confirmation modal before visiting the second stage.
Visit the previously unvisited Technical/RFP stage.
Configure the visited RFP stage with a template.
Assign the evaluator required for the technical stage.
Reopen the publish confirmation after visiting the RFP stage.
Verify the confirmation OK control is enabled after the stage has been visited.
